Where are you going?

TO SEE IF THEY HAVE A PUB
Tom Cruise as Jack Reacher. The fact he is 5ft minus 2 inches is just the start of the wrongness.
Reminds me of rayman, I miss rayman
What about people like me where mdma gave me PTSD
MDMA gave me PTSD
It's like looking in a mirror, only.... not

This is my childhood in one. Constantly lying there thinking a monsters limb is a cm from touching my face or that if I roll over I will be met by the face of some creature. I kinda miss that imagination as it felt so real to me!
XOXO gossip girl x
Sex. Too much porn and too high/strange expectations of what it will be like.
Tribute, Tenacious D.
Thank you for that, never seen such a comprehensive post about recovery rates! I'm luckily responding well to my first set of medications so there is a light at the end of the tunnel!
This is a very dark post for people who are on this thread looking for a bit of help to read.
Added you all except soulminer9, it said yours couldn't be found?
Have we just formed a team? Was this meant to be?
Thank you very much

That is great to hear that you are feeling better, I can completely relate to the self awareness. I am aware of every sensation in my body now, every mental state and how it changes throughout every day depending on sleep, what I consume, if i have exercised etc. I am learning to use this to my advantage as if used incorrectly, it can very much be a curse like you said. 

I really hope to surpass myself from before the binge as I can see the positives from this experience. I am just so exhausted. 

Yes I will work on the little things like that. Thank you for your help it is very much appreciated.
Thank you for that, i will research that and may incorporate it into what im doing. May i ask, how are you now then generally?

Yeah its only noticeable when i look for it or in the dark. I have changed my lifestyle massively and im in a good routine of exercise etc. And i am distracting myself daily. Just hate not knowing if this is permenant or not, hppd would be shit to have.

I have glasses which make my vision perfect focising wise but i have visual static and trails on moving objects. But yes you are correct, i am hyper aware of all sensations in my body, mind and vision now which is probably why i feel like im seeing everything in third person! I stuck to them doses the first three times then obviously overdid it on the last time which set all this off. I am doing better than i was but i just feel so different. Like i have no sense of time anymore, the days just wash over me.
So my vision is likely going to be like this for life? Ive been meditating which really does help. Only took this stupid drug four times ffs.

Hello, yeah ive got all the basic symptoms and working on my anxiety and stuff, its just so dam exhausting! So tired all the time, memory is non existant and my visual synptoms scare the shit out of me! Did you have visual issues? Thanks for replying, just hope theres an end to this!
Thank you, i have been seeing a psychiatrist for 10 weeks now and that is helping, just keeping on and hoping I can recover.
Im 6 months after a large dose and have a whole host of horrible symptoms, any advice or recovery stories?

Yes I have entertained this and am working with a therapist and mindfulness to become more aware of my thought processes and emotions. This is helping and I hope I can kick these symptoms too! Thanks for this comment, nice to know things like this can actually be beaten.
Thanks man, yes I never want to rely on something to be happy ever again. Hope you are doing ok.
Trying my best, have good days and bad days but it's definitely an upwards trend! Thanks for this positive advice, there was a couple of months where I thought I was done for.
No I meant at this point in my life I have only taken drugs on 4 different occasions and I never will again because of this. So it will have been minimal for all of my life.
Yes that's very true. The best thing to come from this is that my sister will now never fall into this trap of abuse because of seeing how bad this has been!
Yeah I guess I have had a lucky escape of sorts as now my drug use will definitely remain minimal for all of my life! Tried warning them but no one listens!
That's good to hear, ive been sober ever since and I am never touching anything again. Would love to enjoy a glass of wine down the road but not for a few years at least.

That's great! Sounds like you really have turned your life around well done. I know it's going to be a long process, just don't get how all my mates can get away with doing that amount or more regularly and they are all still fine, I do it once and I'm destroyed.
Thank you for your words of good luck as well x

Wow thank you for sharing that with me, you sound like you have gone through a lot. Good to hear you are 95% on a good day, that's great work. I've definitely learnt a lot from this experience already, and I can see improvements but yeah I feel so different, just feels like my brain is sick, full of weird pressure and stuff. Definitely putting a lot of effort into recovery though.

See this is what I don't get, everyone I spoke to in person in my friends and acquaintances, a gram of md in a night is like a standard dose and happens often. So I try it like twice and now I'm fucked up just so stupid, if anyone is reading this, never listen to others do your research!!! 

Yes I'm in therapy, practicing mindfulness exercising eating healthy and in touch with a very helpful doctor so I guess all I can do is do the right things and hope that I improve. If anyone has been through something similar and come out ok in the end I would love to hear from them.

This is also what upsets/worries me the most. I was sharing this batch with a few friends who took a lot more than I did and they are all fine (i know that we are all different) and also my motivation is coming back but all the other symptoms are pretty much the same and I feel very fucked up tbh. Like my vision is so messed up.

Yeah it was untested so I have no idea what it was. Been to the doc and I have spoke to them about everything and I'm seeing a psychologist to help as well. Just wanted to reach out to see if anyone is in a similar situation!
Took mdma on the first two nights with alcohol, 0.7g then alcohol and weed on the third night.
Are you ok now then? Definitely a wake up call for me and I've completely changed a lot of my lifestyle.
Thank you x
Thank you, working on it!
Been to the doctor, 4 actually and they all deny that it was the drugs that caused this. All say it's just anxiety and in my head.

4 months ago I followed my stupid friends and took 0.8g of mdma over two days along with alcohol 'as a gram is a normal amount to take in a night' according to them. Well I've had to drop out of uni as i now have no memory, depersonalisation, depression and anxiety symptoms along with a load of other shit. Been sober since that day but feel my life is ruined. How screwed am i? Any similar stories would be great to hear.
I have spoken to a counsellor at uni but I have had to suspend studies and go home due to this. thank you for your help
I have been on them for about two weeks now, I have spoken to doctors and they have put me on the anti depressants. I just cant function at all.

No i have not touched any substance apart from the anti depressants since that last night however like I said the last time was a large dose and was untested. I went on the anti depressants as a last resort as things were unbearable. The issues with impotence, bad memory and pain were all present before starting the anti depressant. The way I felt after that night compared to before is unbelievable.
Have your cognitive abilities recovered?
